title: Safekeep phased autopilot for batching and KV-cache recommendations
creator: Maya Chen
comments: 2026-03-02 — PRD created: outline of phased autopilot that applies batching/KV-cache suggestions behind an escrowed operator latch. Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPT/Safekeep+Autopilot

2026-03-04 — Architecture sync with runtime team. Decided to implement a three-stage rollout: shadow trial (no traffic), canary with traffic-slice + telemetry gates, and graduated rollout with operator escrow. Notes: https://docs.google.com/document/d/architect-safekeep

2026-03-06 — Engineering spike complete. Implemented simulation harness to run 12h replay of customer traffic with suggested batching profiles; results show 18-22% token-cost reduction with <2% P95 latency delta on p3. Benchmark PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8421
2026-03-08 — Design review (Priya Nair): Console UX needs an explicit 'operator escrow' button and clear rollback path. Action: product to mock warning copy and approval flow.
2026-03-10 — Security review kickoff. KMS access pattern verified; audit logging required for auto-applies and rollbacks. Ticket created: SEC-1093
2026-03-11 — Ops feedback: require automatic pause if error-rate delta > 0.5% or latency SLO breaches 3 consecutive windows. Added to telemetry gate spec.
2026-03-12 — Feature flag created (optimize.safekeep.autopilot). Initial rollout behind org-level pilot. Flag dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/flags/optimize.safekeep.autopilot

2026-03-13 — PR opened for rollout controller and canary orchestration: https://github.com/redwood-inference/control-plane/pull/1337 — contains canary scheduler, escrow API, and approval webhook scaffolding.

2026-03-14 — Current: controller integration tests passing. Next: implement operator escalation UI and run a 48h shadow run against two non-prod tenants before canary traffic slice. Assigned follow-ups: ENG-471002 (UI for escrow), ENG-471003 (telemetry gate tuning).
